Name: Foxtrot
Author: SorenWolfe
Punchline: Hear an orchestrion roll before you go and earn it.
Description:
The game will sell you an orchestrion roll for a few hundred thousand gil and tell you nothing about what it sounds like. Foxtrot lets you listen first.

• Right-click a roll in your bags and choose Preview.
• /foxtrot opens a searchable browser of every track in the game, including the ones you do not own yet.
• A small player with play, stop, its own volume and a running time. Star the ones you like.
• The zone music fades down while you listen and comes back when you stop — including if you unload the plugin mid-track.
• Playback goes through the game's own orchestrion call, so it sounds exactly like owning the roll would.
